correctness.rationale: For each idempotent full-support e, a group unit g and inverse h in the full relation monoid satisfy gh=hg=e; any zero row/column of g or h contradicts the corresponding nonzero row/column of e. The row-semilattice action g↦(U↦Ug) is a faithful anti-homomorphism with an explicit inverse based on rows F(e_x); using inversion yields a group isomorphism. Principal upper sets are precisely join irreducibles for a finite poset order idempotent. The marker-chain poset proves every automorphism is a left translation of G; the number of elements and logarithmic generator bound are counted exactly. Small-size exhaustive tests on the actual verify.py independently confirm the group orders for all full-support idempotents of size at most three and the C2 realization.
